items.definition:
in advance; in anticipation
Please prepare all the documents beforehand.

not tightly or firmly
The rope was tied loosely.

in a way that involves or is characterized by physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill
The storm raged violently through the night.

recently, newly
The bread was freshly baked this morning.

in or to the area behind the stage in a theater
The actors waited backstage before the show.

in an interesting way
Interestingly, the experiment yielded unexpected results.

in a way that is not correct or true
He answered the question incorrectly.

in a quiet and peaceful manner
She calmly explained the situation to the police.

in a strange or unusual way
He behaved rather oddly at the party, avoiding everyone.

on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle
All passengers are now on board the aircraft.

in a wonderful manner
The concert was performed wonderfully.

to or from the side
He looked at me sideways.

at high speed; quickly
The bird flew swiftly across the sky.

onto or to the shore
The boat drifted ashore during the storm.

with great interest
She eagerly awaited the results.

in a terrible way
He sang horribly.

In a tidy or orderly way.
She folded her clothes neatly.

in any case; anyway
It started to rain, but we went out anyhow.

with deep affection; at great cost
She loved her grandmother dearly.

every night
She reads a book nightly before bed.

in a way that shows tolerance and understanding
She waited patiently for her turn.

on or onto the stage
The actor walked onstage to thunderous applause.

in a continuing forward direction
They marched onward despite the difficult terrain.

incorrectly; by mistake
He was mistakenly identified as the culprit.

towards a higher place
The road goes uphill for two miles.

In a way that seems to involve magic
The rabbit magically disappeared from the hat.

in a way that is not fair or just
He felt he was treated unfairly.

in a pleasant manner
The weather was pleasantly warm.

towards the west
They traveled westward across the plains.

in an angry manner
He shouted angrily at the driver.

without seeing or without thought/reason
He walked blindly into the dark room.

in a careful and hesitant way
He opened the door cautiously.

in a horizontal direction or position
The line was drawn horizontally across the page.

for each one; to or for each person or thing
The apples cost fifty cents apiece.

towards the east
The ship sailed eastward.

In a responsible manner
Please drive responsibly.

towards the north
The birds flew northward for the winter.

traveling or leading towards the south
The train traveled southbound to Miami.

in the direction of the movement of the hands of a clock
Turn the knob clockwise to open it.

in a way that shows great anger; with great energy or speed
He worked furiously to meet the deadline.

In a clever way
She cleverly solved the puzzle.

in a relaxed or unofficial way
We decided to meet informally for coffee.

in a way that involves the use of imagination or original ideas
She approached the problem creatively.

Towards the south.
The birds flew southward for the winter.

in the third place; as the third point.
Firstly, we need a plan; secondly, we need resources; and thirdly, we need dedication.

in a strange or unusual way
The cat stared at me weirdly from under the bed.

in a careful or gentle way
He delicately placed the fragile vase on the shelf.

in an intelligent manner
She responded to the complex question intelligently.

in alphabetical order
Please arrange the names alphabetically.

In a sweet manner; pleasantly
The bird sang sweetly from the branch.

at an angle; in a diagonal direction
She walked diagonally across the park.

in a smart or intelligent way; in a stylish way
He dressed smartly for the job interview.

in a way that shows a lack of care or attention
He carelessly left his keys on the table.

in an innocent manner
She smiled innocently, pretending she knew nothing about the broken vase.

In a cheerful or lively way.
The children skipped merrily down the path.

in a way that causes embarrassment
It was an embarrassingly bad mistake.

in an energetic manner; with energy
He energetically tackled the new project.

with gratitude
She gratefully accepted the help offered by her friends.

towards home
After a long journey, they finally turned homeward.

toward the north
The birds flew northwards for the winter.

in a way that causes annoyance
The alarm clock kept ringing annoyingly every five minutes.

towards the east
They traveled eastwards along the coast.

further upstream
The salmon swim upriver to spawn.

with a large distance between opposite sides or surfaces; densely
The fog lay thickly over the valley, making driving difficult.
